summary:
Radar for 21 Nov 2026, GLP-1 focus. Thanksgiving is in 5 days, and this is the biggest window this week. The Conversation (19 Nov) and US News (20 Nov) have holiday-feast pieces out, our 'still full the morning after' Short got 504 views on day 1, and 'full after 3 bites' got 429 on IG. Holiday Shorts should run through 11-27 and link to the Thanksgiving long video.

Foundayo (orforglipron) is the best long-form opportunity. I checked that the TGA registered it on 16 Nov and pharmacies in Australia are stocking it now. It was approved in Canada on 13 Nov and is launched in the UK. Our 826-view Foundayo Short and the 476-minute Foundayo long video confirm people search the name. Ship the what-to-expect video with the 2.7% placebo fix, then a pill-vs-shot comparison (SMH, Herald Sun and The Australian are asking 'are the pills as good as Ozempic?').

The NAION eye warning is in a second wave of coverage: Ophthalmology Times ran a Q&A on a baseline eye exam (21 Nov), News-Medical covered it (19 Nov), and Medical Daily reported Denmark compensating 31 people. That refreshes the held Serious Risks video. Use label numbers only and leave out the legal angle.

ScienceDaily's 'why don't GLP-1s work for everyone' (19 Nov) is a good hook for the broad 'Weight Loss: How Much in the Trials?' video. Keep evergreen search formats in rotation: injection sites and pen how-tos per the IFU, hair loss, nausea, months 2–6, and Mounjaro vs Zepbound.

Early items I verified:
- **Prebiotic soda for GI symptoms:** a pilot RCT (80 adults, 4 weeks) is now in Diabetes Obes Metab. Short support only.
- **Disordered eating:** a 60-week placebo-controlled semaglutide RCT from Penn found symptoms improved. It's sensitive, so handle with care.
- **Heart risk:** Health Canada approved Mounjaro's cardiovascular indication.
- **Retatrutide knee pain (TRIUMPH, ACR):** the data are solid, but it's an unapproved pipeline drug, so a news-framed Short only.

Rejected: compounded-tirzepatide price comparisons (FlatRx), employer, Medicaid and coverage stories, black-market peptides, the 'GLP-1 vacation', observational cancer and anemia claims presented as causal, and paediatric trials as headline topics (outside our adult audience).

Sources: [yourlifechoices TGA Foundayo](https://www.yourlifechoices.com.au/health/new-weight-loss-pill-approved-in-australia-without-strict-mealtime-rules/), [The Nightly TGA approval](https://thenightly.com.au/society/health/tga-approves-first-of-its-kind-glp-1-weight-loss-pill-foundayo-for-australian-use-c-23171652), [Pharmacy2U UK launch](https://www.pharmacy2u.co.uk/about/media-centre/news/foundayo-launched-in-the-uk), [ClinicalTrials.gov NCT07744360](https://clinicaltrials.gov/study/NCT07744360), [News-Medical retatrutide knee OA](https://www.news-medical.net/news/20261110/A-weight-loss-drug-eased-knee-arthritis-pain-in-two-major-trials.aspx), [Patient Care retatrutide](https://www.patientcareonline.com/view/retatrutide-phase-3-trials-report-reduced-knee-osteoarthritis-pain), [ScienceDaily non-response](https://sciencedaily.com/releases/2026/11/261118065518.htm), [Scientific American](https://www.scientificamerican.com/article/weight-loss-drugs-dont-work-for-everyone-heres-why/).

candidates.topic: Thanksgiving on tirzepatide: full after 3 bites, heartburn after a big plate, still full the next morning, drinks at the party, leftovers
candidates.angle: Calm 'Is this normal?' holiday moments, each with the relief fact in the same sentence: slower stomach emptying explains why you feel full early. Practical plate order (protein first, smaller portions, eat slowly) without diet rules. Alcohol and low blood sugar caveat for people with diabetes on insulin or a sulfonylurea. Shorts link to the Thanksgiving long video.
keywords: full after a few bites mounjaro
can i drink alcohol on mounjaro
candidates.why_now: Holiday in 5 days. The Conversation (19 Nov) and US News (20 Nov) are both running GLP-1 holiday-feast guides. Our 'still full the morning after' Short got 504 views on day 1. Seventh straight snapshot, holding at about 90.

evidence.signal: Doctor's guide to holiday feasting on GLP-1 medication
How to enjoy the big feast on a GLP-1 without side effects

candidates.topic: Foundayo (orforglipron) pill: what to expect, from the label (now in Australian pharmacies after the TGA's 16 Nov registration, approved in Canada, launched in the UK)
candidates.angle: 'Foundayo (orforglipron) Pill: What to Expect.' Label only: how the daily pill is taken without strict mealtime rules (per the label), common GI effects mostly during dose escalation, the label's Trial 1 in adults without diabetes (-11.1% at the label's top dose of 17.2 mg; 10.3% vs 2.7% stopped for adverse events). Who to ask your prescriber about it. Apply the 11-20 and 11-21 fact-check fixes.
candidates.why_now: I checked that the TGA registered it on 16 Nov and supplies are reaching Australian pharmacies now (RACGP newsGP, AusDoc, Herald Sun, SMH). Health Canada approved it on 13 Nov. Our 11-20 Foundayo nausea Short got 826 views on day 1. 'foundayo' is a search term that already pays for us (476 lifetime minutes).

evidence.signal: TGA approves Foundayo; no strict mealtime rules
TGA approves first-of-its-kind GLP-1 pill Foundayo
Foundayo launched in the UK
US prescribing information

candidates.topic: GLP-1 pills vs tirzepatide shots: Foundayo, the Wegovy pill and Mounjaro compared (approved drugs, labels and pivotal trials)
candidates.angle: Head-to-head question people are asking now that both pills are on Australian shelves: 'Are the pills as effective as the shots?' Give each drug's own pivotal trial result in its own population. Say clearly there is no direct head-to-head trial and don't create a fake one. Cover the different ways each is taken and shared GI effects. Title 'Tirzepatide (Mounjaro) vs GLP-1 Pills: What's Different?'
keywords: are glp-1 pills as good as injections
candidates.why_now: The Australian, SMH and Herald Sun (19–21 Nov) are all asking whether the pills match Ozempic. Fierce Pharma's Oral GLP-1 Tracker (20 Nov). The Endocrine paper (16 Nov) compares oral small-molecule and injectable safety.

evidence.signal: Are the new GLP-1 weight-loss pills as effective as Ozempic?
Safety and tolerability of oral small-molecule vs injectable peptide GLP-1 RAs

candidates.topic: Tirzepatide (Mounjaro) serious risks: how rare are they? NAION eye warning, pancreatitis, gallbladder, low blood sugar, from the label (second wave of NAION coverage)
candidates.angle: Ship the held Serious Risks video with the 11-21 fixes. Calm, number-led framing: what the label now says about NAION, which signs need prompt medical care (sudden vision loss), and why ophthalmologists are discussing a baseline eye exam. Pancreatitis 0.23 vs 0.11 per 100 patient-years only alongside the weight-trial 0.14 vs 0.15. No legal-claims angle.
keywords: how rare is pancreatitis on mounjaro
candidates.why_now: Ophthalmology Times Q&A on a baseline eye exam (21 Nov). News-Medical (19 Nov) on the FDA's class-wide warning. Medical Daily reports Denmark compensating 31 people. FoodNavigator asks whether demand will fall. The video is already scripted and only needs re-timing.

evidence.signal: Q&A: GLP-1 RAs and NAION, the case for a baseline exam
FDA adds rare eye condition warning to GLP-1 medications

candidates.topic: Tirzepatide (Mounjaro) weight loss: how much in the trials, and why some people lose less (hooked to ScienceDaily's 'why don't GLP-1s work for everyone')
candidates.angle: Broad searched question. Give the SURMOUNT-1 averages for each arm in the full trial population and the spread of results, then the plausible reasons the evidence supports for losing less: other medicines such as steroids and some antidepressants, eating patterns, sex differences, and early genetic research labelled as early. End with 'questions to bring to your prescriber'. No dose advice.
keywords: how much weight will i lose on mounjaro
why am i not losing weight on mounjaro
candidates.why_now: ScienceDaily (19 Nov) and Scientific American explainers on non-response are spreading. Fifth snapshot at about 82–84. Broad questions earn about 590 minutes on average, against about 115 for narrow ones.

evidence.signal: Why don't weight-loss drugs like Ozempic and Wegovy work for everyone?
Weight-loss drugs don't work for everyone; here's why

candidates.topic: Tirzepatide injection site reactions: redness, itching, small lumps. Is this normal? (label 6–8% by dose vs about 2% on placebo)
candidates.angle: Calm 'Is this normal?' visible moment with the relief fact in sentence 1. Rotating sites per the Instructions for Use (abdomen, thigh, upper arm), with no amounts. When to call your prescriber. Link to the Pen how-to.
candidates.why_now: Proven winner on our Shorts (254 and 202 views). Device how-to searches outperform channel averages 10–195x in this niche.

evidence.signal: Injection-site reactions 6–8% vs about 2% on placebo

candidates.topic: Mounjaro vs Zepbound: what's actually different? (same molecule, different US approvals and labels, pen vs vial)
candidates.angle: Approved-drug head-to-head that searchers type every day. Same tirzepatide, different approved uses: type 2 diabetes plus the new heart-risk indication (FDA Aug 2026, Health Canada 18 Nov) vs weight reduction, long-term maintenance and obstructive sleep apnea. Devices per the IFU. Mention 'Mounjaro UK' naming.
keywords: is mounjaro the same as zepbound
candidates.why_now: Health Canada's 18–19 Nov approval of Mounjaro's cardiovascular indication refreshes the 'what's different' question. The 11-18 video shows 8% CTR on early impressions, so Shorts linking to it are worthwhile.

evidence.signal: Health Canada approves Mounjaro to reduce cardiovascular risk in adults with T2D

candidates.topic: Tirzepatide hair loss: why it's more common in women (5.4% vs 0.9% on placebo; women 7.1% vs 1.3%, men 0.5% vs 0%) and whether it grows back
candidates.angle: Felt symptom people search. Shedding usually relates to rapid weight loss. Give the label split by sex, typical timing, and the protein and eating-enough link. Supports the retitled Hair Loss long video.
keywords: does hair grow back after mounjaro
candidates.why_now: Our best Short ever was the hair grow-back one (1,026 views), and hair in women got 120. The pending retitle needs Shorts pointing at it.

evidence.signal: Hair loss 5.4% vs 0.9%; by sex

candidates.topic: Tirzepatide (Mounjaro) months 2–6: what to expect (appetite, GI effects easing after dose escalation, the SURMOUNT-1 weight curve, when to call)
candidates.angle: What-to-expect timeline, the next step in the First Month series. Shorts on felt moments in months 2–6 ('appetite came back a bit', 'nausea easing') link into the live Months 2–6 video (Aqv2dOU-SmM). Don't re-produce the long video; it's already live.
candidates.why_now: Timelines are a proven search-demand format. The series playlist is being built now.

evidence.signal: GI effects mostly during dose escalation and decreased over time

candidates.topic: Tirzepatide nausea: why it happens, when it usually eases, and foods that may help (plus the new prebiotic-soda pilot RCT as a supporting fact)
candidates.angle: Felt symptom with a fresh study hook. Nausea is mostly during dose escalation and eases over time. Smaller, blander meals and eating slowly. A new 4-week pilot RCT tested a daily prebiotic soda for GI symptoms in people starting GLP-1 therapy: frame it as 'early, small, interesting', never as a fix, and don't name a brand. Re-render the verified Nausea Foods long video.
candidates.why_now: The pilot RCT was published in Diabetes Obes Metab on 19 Nov (I checked the trial record: 80 adults, 6 g fibre per serving, 4 weeks). The nausea Short got 197 views.

evidence.signal: Prebiotic functional soda and GI symptoms in adults on GLP-1 therapy: randomized pilot
Trial design: 80 participants, 4 weeks

candidates.topic: Keeping results after stopping tirzepatide: what SURMOUNT-4 shows (335 vs 335; +14.0% average regain on placebo, still 9.9% below baseline)
candidates.angle: Broad, positive and trial-only: what happened in the trial, and what helps people keep habits (protein, strength training) alongside talking to a prescriber. Never advise stopping or tapering. Hooked to Healthline's 'Stopping Wegovy or Zepbound?' (19 Nov). Treat the SCMP stroke story as observational context only.
keywords: what happens when you stop mounjaro
how to keep weight off after mounjaro
candidates.predicted_peak: 5–14 days (New Year intentions build after the holidays)
candidates.why_now: Healthline (19 Nov) and SCMP (20 Nov) cover stopping. Our Stopping video gained +20 minutes today. Sixth snapshot.

evidence.signal: Stopping Wegovy or Zepbound? How to keep weight off

candidates.topic: Lifting weights on tirzepatide: T-REx RCT (Nature Medicine) keeps muscle, now in MarketWatch and ThinkPol pickup; apitegromab add-on trial as context
candidates.angle: 'Will I lose muscle on tirzepatide?' What the trial showed: less lean-mass loss and better strength with similar weight loss. A beginner-friendly first step. Mention that the muscle-drug add-on trial (apitegromab) slowed lean-mass loss without functional gains, which is why lifting stays the base. Don't touch the Strength long video until 11-24.
keywords: how to keep muscle on zepbound
candidates.why_now: MarketWatch (21 Nov) and ThinkPol (20 Nov) are fresh coverage, plus the apitegromab news (21 Nov). Strength (704 min) is a top earner.

evidence.signal: What's been proven to help GLP-1 users from losing too much muscle

candidates.topic: Do GLP-1 medicines make eating disorders worse? 60-week placebo-controlled semaglutide RCT (Int J Eat Disord, Penn, 15–19 Nov) found binge-eating symptoms and body image improved
candidates.angle: Myth correction in a gentle tone: in adults with BMI over 27, disordered-eating attitudes improved on semaglutide vs placebo. Medscape notes new cases are rare but can occur. Signpost support. No weight-loss-pressure messaging. Name semaglutide because the evidence is semaglutide-only.
candidates.why_now: RCT plus a Penn press release (19 Nov), NewsNation, PhillyVoice, Medscape and Bioengineer (21 Nov). Creator coverage is thin.

evidence.signal: 60-week randomized placebo-controlled trial
Semaglutide may improve eating disorder symptoms and body image

candidates.topic: Eating enough on tirzepatide: protein and nutrients when appetite is low (UK nutrient-shortfall study, 'eating far too little' report)
candidates.angle: Positive 'get the most from it' piece: why low appetite can leave protein, fibre and micronutrient gaps, plus two practical habits. Present the small UK study as a small study. No calorie targets, no extreme-diet framing.
candidates.why_now: Nutrition Insight and StudyFinds (19 Nov). What to Eat gained +30 minutes today.

evidence.signal: Wegovy and Mounjaro linked to nutrient shortfalls in small UK study

candidates.topic: Tirzepatide (Mounjaro) and your heart: SURPASS-CVOT vs dulaglutide; Health Canada heart-risk approval (18 Nov) after the FDA (Aug 2026)
candidates.angle: Benefits beyond weight, with exact scope: adults with type 2 diabetes and established cardiovascular disease, compared against an active drug (dulaglutide), not placebo. Questions to bring to your doctor.
candidates.why_now: Health Canada approval covered by BioSpace on 19 Nov. Fourth snapshot. The HFpEF SUMMIT substudy (HCPLive, 20 Nov) adds a second hook.

evidence.signal: Health Canada approves Mounjaro to reduce CV risk in adults with T2D
SUMMIT substudy: tirzepatide and LV/atrial metrics in HFpEF

candidates.topic: Skin hurts or tingles on a GLP-1? Sensory skin disturbance (dysesthesia) reports in people without diabetes (Pharmacy Times, 20 Nov)
candidates.angle: 'Is this normal?' felt symptom. Explain what's reported, that it's uncommon and the evidence is mostly case-level, and that you should tell your prescriber. Label figures only if the tirzepatide label lists it.
candidates.why_now: Second Pharmacy Times item in a week (16 and 20 Nov), with almost no creator coverage. Fits the proven felt-symptom Shorts format.

evidence.signal: Semaglutide-associated sensory skin disturbance in patients without diabetes

candidates.topic: Retatrutide and knee osteoarthritis pain: two phase 3 TRIUMPH trials (63–70% halved pain vs 38% placebo), unapproved pipeline drug
candidates.angle: News framing only, as a Short: 'weight loss and knee pain', with tirzepatide context that losing weight eases joint load. State clearly that retatrutide is not approved. Never imply access. Reject any supplier angle. Not a 'What is retatrutide?' long video (the ban applies).
candidates.why_now: ScienceDaily (20 Nov), plus ACR coverage in Healio, News-Medical and Patient Care. The data are solid but it's a pipeline drug, so pipeline Shorts sit at 7–56 views for us.

evidence.signal: Weight-loss drug eased knee arthritis pain in two major trials
Retatrutide phase 3: WOMAC pain -4.48 vs -2.43 placebo

candidates.topic: REJECT: compounded-tirzepatide price comparisons (FlatRx), employer, Medicaid and coverage stories, black-market peptides (NZ), the 'GLP-1 vacation', observational cancer-prevention and anemia claims as causal, paediatric trials as the headline
candidates.angle: Do not produce. Compounded and gray-market sourcing, cost and coverage are banned topics. Causal claims from observational cancer or anemia data would mislead. Paediatric trials fall outside our adult audience and are sensitive.
candidates.why_now: High news volume this cycle, but every one of these breaks a channel guardrail.
